comments.content: The popLast implementation has O(n) complexity per part removed due to full_name.resize() in a loop. Consider computing the total size to remove first, then doing a single resize for better performance when removing multiple parts.
IdentifierView::popFirst uses assert() while Identifier::popFirst uses chassert(). For consistency and debug builds, consider using chassert() here as well.
IdentifierView::popLast uses assert() while Identifier::popLast uses chassert(). For consistency, consider using chassert() here as well.
